role: Armoured duellist - Earth's ground forged by Fire [B]
rule: Metal is worn and wielded: its hits ignore front armour and do +25% per metal class the target wears, and every metal blow on the same enemy heats your edge (Edge Heat, up to 5, +8% each); strike another, or go 3 s without a metal blow, and it cools.

new_mechanics.name: Edge Heat (focus)
new_mechanics.definition: Metal rule, player-side like Slipstream's pips: a metal hit on the same enemy as your last metal hit adds 1 Edge Heat (up to focus_max 5); each stack makes metal hits focus_mult (+8%) harder. A metal hit on another enemy starts again at 1 on that one; focus_cools_s (3 s) with no metal hit drops it to 0. Area side-effects (spall, bursts) neither add nor reset it. Keys on the affinity: focus_max, focus_mult, focus_cools_s. It is Fire's heat (a multiplier you build) narrowed to one opponent.

skills.name: Weld Line
skills.summary: A line of molten iron thrown at one enemy, 9 m: 30 damage, it is dragged 3 m toward you, and for 5 s it is welded to you and Taunted - it fights you, and if you walk away it comes along, out of its pack.
skills.verb_fit: Fuse is "weld two into one piece": you and one enemy, joined. Fire's heat makes the weld; Earth's hold keeps it on your ground. The duel starts here.

new_mechanics.name: tether_to_caster
new_mechanics.definition: The Fused status's partner is the caster: the enemy is held within tether_m of you while it lasts. Walk away and it is dragged after you, out of its pack; you are not held. A stone or wall between you breaks it.

good_modifiers.word: Clasping Weld: it cannot attack anyone but you - Shackled for a moment

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: split apart what you are joining. The two cancel
a duel with many is not a duel: the jump welds a second enemy you did not choose
a line that passes through cannot hold what it hits; pierce fights the pull

skills.change_note: Was Spot Weld (two enemies welded together, a chain). Now one enemy welded to you, pulled in and Taunted: the duellist's ranged starter. Same rune, same verb (two into one piece). Renamed; id kept. Cost 12 -> 8 (starter tier); 45 -> 30 damage.

skills.name: Splitting Blow
skills.summary: One enemy in reach: a cleaving blow, 2.4x strike damage and 60 poise. If it wears metal, its armour splits open and the pieces fly on behind it: 30 per metal class to everyone within 2.5 m.
skills.verb_fit: Sunder is "split it apart": Earth's Crumble (break the guard) forged, and the spall is Earth's stone shrapnel in steel - but aimed at the one in front of you.

good_modifiers.word: Wide Spall: the pieces fly farther
Stripping Split: its armour is torn off too

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: join what you are splitting. The two cancel
armouring the one you are splitting; it should not act
a blow in reach already lands; pierce is wasted

skills.change_note: One target now (was a 120-degree cleave): the duellist's close starter. 1.8x -> 2.4x, 50 -> 60 poise; the spall still reaches the pack behind it.

skills.name: Breakthrough
skills.summary: Drive forward 5 m, point first. A bare enemy in the way stops you and is knocked back 1.5 m. One that wears metal is punched through: 40 damage, you carry on past it, and it is Stripped for 4 s.
skills.verb_fit: Breach is "break a seal; punch through plate": Earth's Bedrock Shove made a lunge - point first, through the armour, onto the one you want.

good_modifiers.word: Keen Breakthrough: the pass cuts harder

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: close what you are breaking through. It should not act
a lunge has nothing that lasts but the strip; falls back
a lunge onto the one in front, somewhere else; falls back

skills.name: Red Iron
skills.summary: You draw the iron red-hot: your Edge Heat is full on the next enemy you strike, everything within 2 m takes 20 as the heat comes off you, and for 6 s every bare strike you land sets its target Alight.
skills.verb_fit: Forge is "shape and harden metal": Fire's Stoke in iron - the forge's heat put straight into the edge you fight with.

new_mechanics.name: set_focus
new_mechanics.definition: A skill with set_focus 'max' fills Edge Heat to focus_max on the next enemy you hit with metal.

good_modifiers.word: Keen Iron: the burn and the edge harder

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: corrode the edge you are forging. It should not act
your blade has no range; falls back to a cost cut
the heat is for one opponent; nothing to copy. Falls back

skills.name: Whetted Cut
skills.summary: Hold to draw your weapon's edge keen, up to 1.5 s, walking at 45%. Let go for one cut across 60 degrees and 3.3 m: 1.6x strike damage at a tap, up to 3.2x at a full hold - and it spends your Edge Heat for +0.3x a stack.
skills.verb_fit: Hone is "sharpen": the edge the whole duel has been heating, spent in one cut - Fire's burst (Hiss cashes a burn; this cashes the edge).

new_mechanics.name: focus_spend
new_mechanics.definition: The skill spends all Edge Heat when it lands: + per_focus_mult x the stacks spent to its damage_mult.

good_modifiers.word: Stripping Cut: the cut tears armour off
Splitting Cut: more poise and reach

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: blunt the edge you are honing. It should not act
a cut has nothing that lasts; falls back
a cut in reach already lands; pierce is wasted

skills.change_note: Spends Edge Heat for +0.3x a stack (five stacks: +1.5x): the duel's finisher.

skills.name: Turn the Edge
skills.summary: A 0.5 s guard, Braced. The first blow aimed at you from within 2.5 m is taken on your blade and does nothing: the attacker is Dulled for 6 s, Staggered (your next strike on it is an Opening), and becomes your Edge Heat target with 2 stacks. The ringing Dulls anyone else within 2 m. If nothing comes, half the essence comes back.
skills.verb_fit: Dull is "blunt edges, theirs included: take a blow on your blade": Earth's Root (stand and take it) in steel - you do not move, the blow does.

new_mechanics.name: focus_gain
new_mechanics.definition: On a counter, the attacker becomes your Edge Heat target with this many stacks added.

good_modifiers.word: Plated Guard: the guard lasts longer
Splitting Guard: the ring reaches farther

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: sharpen the edge you are turning dull. It should not act
a guard you move out of is a dodge, and that is Wind's; held still it works, moving it fails
a guard only works on what reaches you; falls back

skills.change_note: Was a 360-degree sweep (it sat too near Earth's Tremor). Now a parry on the counter key set (Holy's Abiding Guard, with Wind's refund_unused): Wind slips behind, Metal stands and takes it on the blade.

skills.name: Plating
skills.summary: For 8 s the metal you wear thickens: every blow on you does 30% less, and a blade that lands on you from within 2.5 m is Dulled for 3 s. You move at full speed.
skills.verb_fit: Plate is "armour up": Earth's Stonehide worn instead of grown - less of it, but you keep your feet and your speed for the duel.

new_mechanics.name: attacker_reach
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff's attacker_status lands only on melee attackers within this distance of you (a long reach weapon from farther does not get it).

good_modifiers.word: Blunting Plate: attackers are Dulled longer

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: tear off the armour you are putting on. It should not act
your armour has no range; falls back to a cost cut
a shell is the opposite of within; falls back

skills.change_note: 25% -> 30% less, and no longer slows you (was 10% slower): the armoured duellist moves; the area tank (Stonehide, 40% less, 25% slower) does not. attacker_reach (2.5 m) is now a number.

skills.name: Wrench
skills.summary: One enemy in reach: you get a grip on its armour and wrench it off. 1.6x strike damage, interrupted, and Stripped for 8 s: no front armour, and it takes 20% more from everything. It no longer counts as armoured, so metal loses its own bonus on it.
skills.verb_fit: Strip is "tear armour off": Earth's Crumble (break the guard) done by hand, to the one in front of you.

good_modifiers.word: Splitting Wrench: more poise and the pieces fly

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: armour what you are stripping. It should not act
already in reach; pierce is wasted
no wind-up to cut; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Iron Slug
skills.summary: You hammer a slug out of the iron you carry and hurl it: 70 damage and 35 poise. Like every metal hit it ignores a raised shield and hits plate hardest: 105 on a plated enemy.
skills.verb_fit: Forge is "shape and harden metal": Earth's Slingstone (a heavy thrown thing), forged in Fire. Metal's plain reach to a runner it does not want to weld.

bad_modifiers.why: no wind-up to cut; falls back to a little power
a slug in flight has nothing that lasts; falls back
its own opposite: corrode the slug you forged. It should not act

skills.change_note: No longer the ranged starter (Weld Line is). Numbers unchanged; it keeps metal's plain ranged hit.

skills.name: Iron Clasp
skills.summary: One enemy within 9 m: a band of iron snaps shut round its arms. 25 damage, interrupted, and Shackled for 2.5 s: it can still walk, but cannot attack. Each metal class it wears adds 1 s.
skills.verb_fit: Seal is "close and lock with metal": Earth's Bury (one body held fast), by the arms. The duellist shackles the second foe so the first stays a duel.

good_modifiers.word: Rusting Clasp: the band corrodes it too

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: break the seal you are closing. It should not act
nothing to pierce; falls back
a band on its arms does not travel; falls back

skills.name: Rust Bloom
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: rust blooms over a circle 3.5 m across for 7 s. Anything inside that wears metal is Rusting: 6 damage a second per metal class, and its front armour is halved. Bare skin does not care.
skills.verb_fit: Rust is "corrode it": Fire's Slag Pool (ground that keeps eating what stands on it), for iron.

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: forge what you are corroding. It should not act
nothing to pierce; falls back
a bloom does not travel; falls back

skills.change_note: No change in play: Rusting's 6 a second per class is written on the payload so power has a field.
